name: agenthub
description: Coordination hub for several people running AI coding agents on one codebase (Phase 1: hub + adapter with enforced file-level leases).

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contract --noEmit && tsc -p packages/gitops --noEmit && tsc -p packages/symbols --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hub --noEmit && tsc -p packages/lander --noEmit && tsc -p packages/adapter --noEmit
